steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and measurable project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour thresholds based on your academic background and work history. Granite PM Academy's admissions team can clarify whether your profile meets the credential's prerequisites before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Formal Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course designed for working professionals. Attend synchronous sessions from anywhere, covering the PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world scenarios. This structured classroom time fulfills PMI's mandatory education requirement and builds exam readiness.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application and Fee
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your official PMP application to PMI with documentation of your education and project experience. Pay the PMI examination fee to activate your exam eligibility. Granite PM Academy staff can guide you through the online submission process and timeline.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—including practice exams, study guides, and instructor Q&A sessions—to reinforce your knowledge. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's authorized testing partner. Sit for the four-hour, 180-question PMP exam on your chosen date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential Across Three Years
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to earning professional development units (PDUs) throughout a three-year renewal cycle. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education courses and PDU-eligible training to help you stay current and meet PMI's recertification standard.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
